rationale: The answer correctly anchors CAPEC-607 and identifies CAPEC-548 as a related attack pattern, but it does not explicitly state that CAPEC-548 can precede CAPEC-607. It also omits the expected alternate name 'Data Spill When information is handled by an information system of a classification/sensitivity for which the system has not been authorized to handle.' The stated facts are supported by the CAPEC-607 record, so the failure is mainly omission rather than fabrication.
